reviews.text: Dr. Meyer is an incredible veterinarian, as well as being a very empathetic and gentle person with animals. I've been very anxious since losing one of my two cats, and she always knows how to reassure me and find the right words. You can take your furry friends there with complete confidence! Thank you again for everything ♥
A caring and attentive veterinarian for our cat

An excellent veterinarian with incredible kindness, empathy, and a gentleness towards animals that I've never seen anywhere else.
She takes the time to analyze and explain... truly top-notch. For her, the health of our animals is paramount.
Experience and compassion, a far cry from the large clinic chains that only think about profits.
A very kind and pleasant person, she and her assistant handled the approach with my very, very fearful cat very well. I highly recommend her 👌🏻 …
A huge thank you for your kindness and professionalism. When I moved to the neighborhood, I never imagined I'd find such excellent care for my two cats. A thousand thanks again! 😀😸😸 …

A very competent and attentive veterinarian; you can tell he takes the time to do his job properly and cares for the animals with seriousness.

However, there are consistently long delays. It's best not to make any plans after the appointment, as the wait can be quite long (over an hour).

This professional duo showed our little kitten a great deal of care.
They gave excellent advice, were attentive, and non-judgmental. Go there without hesitation.

I went there with my Swiss White Shepherd for a booster vaccination. She was very gentle, understanding, and offered helpful advice. You can tell the vet is passionate and thorough; she took the time to check his ears, teeth, claws, bladder, etc.

I highly recommend her!
My three cats have never received such excellent care from a vet. Fantastic vet, I highly recommend him.

Excellent veterinary practice, where you can also have orders delivered from the Veto website, avenue. You are always warmly welcomed and given excellent advice by Dr. Meyer or his assistant; I highly recommend them in the neighborhood.

In addition to being professional and conscientious, Dr. Meyer is very gentle and reassuring (with animals as well as humans!).
I have entrusted her with my cat's health for years without hesitation.

An extraordinary team! Gentleness, kindness, and clear explanations are always present from the moment you arrive. Dr. Meyer genuinely cares about animals and doesn't push unnecessary treatments—quite the opposite! We're moving and will therefore have to change veterinarians, which is a shame!

Mimie died in that clinic after a simple haircut, following a complication during her anesthesia. The problem was that we had specifically stated we didn't want anesthesia. The vet offered us gas sedation (even though she wasn't equipped for it). Completely at fault and responsible, she didn't take responsibility for her mistake; worse, she tried to charge me for the treatment and even tried to prevent my son from attending the cremation. She is very pleasant and attentive when everything goes smoothly. The other side of her personality is far less angelic.

I took Mimie to have a large, matted ball of fur removed. When making the appointment, I was adamant that I refused general anesthesia. The vet offered me light sedation with gas (I later learned she didn't have this equipment). That evening, instead of picking up my cat, the vet told me there had been complications related to the anesthesia… Mimie never came home. I won't go into the vet's underhanded attempts to excuse herself or explain why general anesthesia had been administered without my consent. I won't go into the fact that she tried to charge us for the procedure, and I won't go into the fact that she tried to prevent me from attending my cat's cremation. She seemed very nice on the surface, but everyone should draw their own conclusions about the rest. Personally, I don't expect a veterinarian to be nice to me, but professional with my animals!
Excellent vet, great advice, I highly recommend him 👍 …

On a friend's advice, I turned to Dr. Meyer when I got my kitten 15 years ago. After several moves, even though I now live in the west of Lyon, I still go to her first choice, even though it's far, because she's wonderful. I have complete confidence in her.
A veterinarian who was recommended to me. She is very calm, attentive, and professional. A veterinarian you can trust.
She takes excellent care of animals. I recommend her without hesitation ☺️

This veterinary clinic was highly recommended to me when I adopted my puppy, and I understand why. The reception is always pleasant, gentle, kind, and reassuring. Dr. Meyer is wonderful: she cares for animals with gentleness and respect. She genuinely cares about her little patients and takes the time to answer all questions. The veterinary assistant is very professional and lovely. She always greets you with a smile and great kindness, and takes the time to answer even the smallest questions. Kudos to this duo! Thank you for taking such good care of my Léon (and all the others); it's always a pleasure to visit the clinic.
Excellent veterinarian, very professional, welcoming team who are very involved in animal care.

Dr. Meyer and her assistant are kind and caring people. They are always available and attentive.

In case of emergency, we can count on them to take care of our pet.

We are grateful for the excellent care they provide for our beloved furry friends.
The vet and her assistant are very kind and professional; we had all our consultations done here (spaying/neutering, vaccinations, etc.) for kittens to adults.

This vet treated my cats for years. She's very gentle and truly loves animals.

I'm so sorry I moved and had to change vets!

What a warm welcome, such gentleness, and such love for animals!

I highly recommend her. Reassuring, professional, and full of helpful advice for my cat and dogs, Dr. Anne has been taking care of my animals for many years (throughout their lives and, sadly, through their final days with such kindness). Bravo and a thousand thanks!
Animals are human beings just like us. Our little friends are treated as such at this veterinary clinic. A blessing for our neighborhood. Thank you, Dr. Meyer...
Lovely welcome, impeccable care and attention for my dog ​​🐶 …
A very welcoming, professional, and competent veterinarian. All my animals have received excellent care from her.

An exceptional veterinarian who was always very gentle and reassuring with my cat. Thank you to you and your assistant for your empathy and kindness, and for allowing me to give my little Isba a peaceful and serene end. I will definitely return when I have a new little companion.
The vet is nice. Her work is well done.
My two 19-year-old cats are treated by Dr. Meyer. She is very professional, a great listener, always available, and so gentle with our four-legged friends. I highly recommend her!

I've been going to Dr. Meyer for years. She's very professional, attentive, incredibly gentle with animals, and always punctual.

The same goes for emergencies, which have always been handled quickly and efficiently. I highly recommend her!
